legend.review: none = high-confidence, no action needed · confirm = low-confidence or authored, needs ACCEPT/MODIFY/REJECT · open = genuinely undefined, reviewer may direct or leave open

decisions.decision: Primary action = pill, filled Cavendish Yellow #FFE01B with a 1px ink ring (box-shadow 0 0 0 1px #231E15 — live-measured), label in Peppercorn ink. On yellow/warm fields, primary switches to the dark variant. Secondary = outline pill (2px ink inset).
decisions.evidence: live DOM: CTA fill rgb(255,224,27) + dark inverse variant observed; pill radius 26px on ~44px height
decisions.reasoning: The two variants were both observed live; contrast switching follows from the yellow-on-yellow failure mode.
decisions.alternatives: single flat hierarchy (rejected: two variants observed)

decisions.decision: All buttons are pills (radius = half height, ~26px); label sizing left UNDEFINED per Gate 2 review (13/500 withdrawn); no square buttons anywhere. The ink ring applies to all pills.
decisions.evidence: live computed styles: border-radius 26px; label 13px/500
decisions.reasoning: Directly measured.
decisions.alternatives: 8px default radius (documented but not the CTA reality)

decisions.decision: Hover end-state for pills (live-measured): translateY(-4.875px) + hard ink shadow 0 4.875px 0 0 (zero blur), on cubic-bezier(0.5,2.5,0.7,0.7) at 0.3s; no soft shadows. Other interactive elements: fast ~0.15s feedback.
decisions.evidence: re-probe measured end-state: transform matrix(1,0,0,1,0,-4.875); box-shadow 'rgb(35,30,21) 0 0 0 1px, rgb(35,30,21) 0 4.875px 0 0'
decisions.reasoning: Transition targets (transform, box-shadow) imply a lift+shadow response; magnitude authored to stay gentle.
decisions.alternatives: scale-only; glow highlight (rejected: not in evidence)

decisions.decision: Two registers: soft-serif display for hero/section headlines (with an italic emphasis fragment allowed inside a headline); grotesque sans for all body, UI, labels and metadata. Serif is the exception, never the working voice.
decisions.evidence: font histogram ~5% serif vs ~95% sans; italic emphasis pattern in live headlines
decisions.reasoning: Measured distribution + recurring headline pattern.

decisions.decision: Screen scale: display 48–64px w400 tight tracking (−1.2px at 64); section 35px/1.0; body 16/1.35; small 14; labels/buttons 13/500.
decisions.evidence: live computed styles; indicative scale 14→48
decisions.reasoning: Directly measured; marketing vs product ramps reconciled.

decisions.decision: Roles: yellow = brand field + primary action only; peppercorn = text, ink, shadow tint; white + Parsnip = surfaces; Ochre = section band terminator; Kale = links inside content; #BF4055 = error text/fills.
decisions.evidence: brand-assets names; live surfaces; indicative tokens for kale/error
decisions.reasoning: Core roles observed live; link/error roles from indicative source, flagged for confirmation.
decisions.alternatives: peppercorn links (also live in some spots — conflict noted in evidence)

decisions.decision: Content cards: white, borderless, radius 16 (24 for large), elevation via warm ink-tinted shadow rgba(35,30,21,.2) 0 8px 32px; interior padding 48. Tinted variant: Parsnip, no shadow. 1px borders (#DEDDDC) only on inputs/dividers, never as card devices.
decisions.evidence: live computed styles (shadow string, radii, 48px padding, border token)
decisions.reasoning: Directly measured across elements.
decisions.alternatives: bordered cards (contradicts observed borderless + shadow pattern)

decisions.decision: Shape encodes class: interactive = pill (always with the 1px ink ring); content vessel = 16/24 soft-radius; structural chrome (bands, dividers, page blocks) = square.
decisions.evidence: radius histogram (0px dominant + pills + 16/24 cards)
decisions.reasoning: The mixed histogram reads as a deliberate class system, not noise.

decisions.decision: 8px base scale (8/16/24/32/48); section padding 56–72; card interior 48; button padding 12/24.
decisions.evidence: live paddings (40/68/60/48/12×24) + indicative 8px base
decisions.reasoning: All observed values are multiples of 8 or half-steps.

decisions.decision: One page title; sections = small uppercase label → display headline → 1–2 sentence paragraph. Numbers may take display treatment for proof moments.
decisions.evidence: live section pattern; 1×h1 vs 25×h2 counts; number-led proof
decisions.reasoning: Recurring observed pattern.

decisions.decision: Top bar: white background; dark links; dropdown items carry chevrons; hover = light-grey rounded-rect fill; primary CTA at right end; must stay single-row (no wrapping).
decisions.evidence: live nav (Gate 2 screenshot): white bar, chevron dropdowns, light-grey hover fill
decisions.reasoning: Directly measured.
decisions.alternatives: solid bar (rejected for hero pages; may be needed on content pages — flagged)

decisions.decision: Inputs: white fill, 1px #DEDDDC border, radius 8, 16px text, label above in 14/500; focus = 3px yellow ring (outer, offset 2). Error = border+message in #BF4055.
decisions.evidence: border token + 8px radius documented; focus treatment not evidenced
decisions.reasoning: Extends the documented field language; yellow ring is the only on-brand focus signal.

decisions.decision: Native select styled as a field for small fixed sets (≤ ~12): more rounded (12px) with serif field text per Gate 2 review. Larger or filtered selection out of scope; use the platform-controls fallback and mark it.
decisions.evidence: no picker evidence captured; product shows list-based interactions at scale
decisions.reasoning: Keeping the pledge honest: no invented searchable picker canon.
decisions.alternatives: invent a combobox pattern (rejected: no evidence)

decisions.decision: Status = word-first pill: neutral (Parsnip bg, ink text), attention (Ochre bg, ink text), positive (ink text, no colour — word carries it), problem (#BF4055 tint bg, dark red text). Colour supports the word; never replaces it.
decisions.evidence: no status component observed; error colour indicative; ochre/parsnip surfaces observed
decisions.reasoning: Derived from the warm neutral + single-accent discipline; avoids inventing new hues.
decisions.alternatives: green/red dots (rejected: no green exists in the system)

decisions.decision: Inline notices (rounded 12, tinted fill) rather than floating toasts; copy is plain, non-blaming, question-first.
decisions.evidence: validation copy observed (non-blaming, plain); no toast pattern observed anywhere
decisions.reasoning: Follows observed copy+tone; toasts use a component that does not exist in evidence.

decisions.decision: High-consequence actions route through a rounded confirm dialog (16px) with a consequence sentence in the warm voice; confirm = ink-filled pill labelled with the concrete verb (never 'OK'); cancel = outline pill. Destructive is never the default focus.
decisions.evidence: no destructive pattern captured; dialog styling inferred from card language
decisions.reasoning: Uses only observed primitives (card, pill, voice).
decisions.alternatives: inline two-step reveal; typed confirmation (both rejected as heavier than the brand's register)

decisions.decision: Dialog: white 16px card, 48px padding, warm ink scrim (rgba(35,30,21,.35)); instant appearance (no motion defined; none invented).
decisions.evidence: shadow/card language observed; motion undefined
decisions.reasoning: Same vessel as content cards; motion gap carried, not filled.
decisions.alternatives: fade/slide entrance (rejected: motion undefined in source)

decisions.decision: Progress = pill track (Parsnip) with yellow fill in flight, ink fill when complete, plus a text readout ('7 of 10 steps'). Job actions: start / restart as pills; pause-and-resume allowed (named flow in the product).
decisions.evidence: multi-step editor with pause-and-resume named in product notes; no visual captured
decisions.reasoning: Tracks observed primitives; readout keeps it honest without animation.

decisions.decision: Empty state = tinted Parsnip panel with one warm sentence + one action pill ('Add your first item').
decisions.evidence: no empty state captured; voice + tinted surface observed
decisions.reasoning: Composes observed primitives; copy follows the observed warm-plain register.
decisions.alternatives: illustration-led empty state (deferred: illustration system exists but is not reproduced)

decisions.decision: Ledger: white surface, 16px padded rows, hairline #DEDDDC dividers (no zebra striping), header row in Parsnip with 13/500 labels; row hover = Parsnip tint; status pill inline; text links in ink with underline.
decisions.evidence: pricing comparison table observed; hairline border token; link treatment observed
decisions.reasoning: Extends the observed table language to the register list.

decisions.decision: Emphasis badges: pill, yellow fill, 12/600 label (e.g. 'Most popular' on the selected plan/category).
decisions.evidence: live 'Most Popular' badge
decisions.reasoning: Direct observation.

decisions.decision: Second person, question-first, plain English, non-blaming; dry wit allowed in microcopy; italic serif emphasis fragment allowed in headlines.
decisions.evidence: multiple live samples + brand voice descriptions
decisions.reasoning: Quoted register across sources.

decisions.decision: Illustration is a real system capability but treated as optional garnish: allowed in empty/loading moments, restrained, never over functional content. Not reproduced in the reference build (no asset library).
decisions.evidence: illustration system named and described as restrained; no assets reproduced by policy
decisions.reasoning: Matches the observed restraint rule; keeps the build free of cloned art.
decisions.alternatives: placeholder illustrations (rejected: would fabricate the asset library)

decisions.decision: Single-column collapse; hero display scales 64→40; sticky bar keeps height; no evidence of mobile-specific patterns — carried UNSPECIFIED beyond collapse.
decisions.evidence: no responsive evidence captured (single viewport probe)
decisions.reasoning: Minimal, honest collapse rather than invented responsive canon.

decisions.decision: Focus = 3px yellow ring (outer). On yellow surfaces, focus switches to the ink ring.
decisions.evidence: focus treatment not evidenced anywhere
decisions.reasoning: Yellow is the natural focus signal; the on-yellow switch follows the CTA contrast rule (W-01).

decisions.decision: Never: pure black text/shadows; clinical neutral greys as the palette; square primary buttons; 1px borders as card devices; decorative use of yellow; invented hues beyond the palette.
decisions.evidence: absence of these across all observed material + stated warm-ink discipline
decisions.reasoning: The prohibitions codify what the evidence never does.
